english.note: Use 經典 as the all-purpose choice for canonical or timelessly excellent works, and colloquially for a predictably apt or funny moment.
Use 經典 for a canonical or benchmark work, and in technical contexts for non-quantum models.
Use this for works or authors recognized as classic and exemplary rather than merely acceptable.
